categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen VMAX New Energy Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, production, sales, and technical services of new energy vehicle power domain products. Its main products include onboard power supplies such as onboard chargers, DC/DC converters, integrated power supply products, electric drive systems including motor controllers and drive assemblies, electric vehicle communication controllers (EVCC), and liquid-cooled charging pile modules. The company also engages in software development related to these products through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary technologies such as magnetic integration control decoupling, output port circuit integrated control, single-phase and three-phase charging compatibility, V2X technology for bidirectional charging and discharging, OBC inverter safety control, reverse pre-charging, high-efficiency cooling structures, multi-in-one power domain controllers, dual motor controllers, liquid cooling for supercharging piles, software fast online upgrade, EV communication control, semiconductor switch device pre-assembly and welding, third-generation semiconductor material application, 800V high-voltage platform development, and fully automated assembly technology. Production methods include high-level automation with digital factories built to Industry 4.0 standards, automated assembly lines, and intelligent warehouses to improve efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are domestic and international new energy vehicle manufacturers, including leading Chinese new car makers such as XPeng Motors, Hozon Auto, Leapmotor, SAIC Group, Geely, Changan, Chery, and joint ventures like Dongfeng Nissan and SAIC-GM. It also serves overseas automotive groups such as Stellantis, Renault, Aston Martin, and Ferrari. The company supports both domestic and export markets, with a growing share in overseas sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Shanghai, Wuhu, and other locations. It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Japan, and overseas markets. The company actively pursues a 'go global' strategy, expanding its presence in international markets, particularly in Europe and North America through partnerships with global automotive brands.
categories.supply_chain_position: VMAX operates primarily as a midstream supplier in the new energy vehicle supply chain, specializing in core components such as onboard power supplies and electric drive systems. It supplies these critical parts directly to vehicle manufacturers, positioning itself as a Tier 1 supplier with strong integration capabilities and close collaboration with OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous independent R&D and technological innovation, focusing on product integration, high-voltage platforms, multifunctionality, and new material applications like third-generation semiconductors. It invests heavily in R&D, with a 40.53% increase in spending in 2023, and maintains a large, highly educated R&D team. The company also emphasizes expanding product lines, including integrated electric drive systems, EVCC, and liquid-cooled charging modules, while enhancing automated production capacity and global market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of products to new energy vehicle manufacturers under a direct sales model. The company obtains orders mainly through synchronous development with OEMs, involving customized product development and certification before mass production. Revenue recognition is based on delivery and customer acceptance, with settlement methods including consignment and non-consignment sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: VMAX holds a leading position in the Chinese onboard charger market, ranking second with an 18.8% market share in passenger car onboard chargers and first in third-party supply market shipments with a 32.38% share. It competes with traditional automotive parts suppliers, new energy vehicle OEMs with in-house capabilities, and other power electronics firms entering the market. Its strong R&D, production scale, and diversified customer base provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.52 billion, a 44.09% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 502 million, up 70.47%. Total assets grew 78.17% to RMB 7.23 billion, and shareholders' equity increased 227.52% to RMB 3.38 billion, reflecting rapid growth fueled by market expansion and a successful IPO. The company maintains strong cash flow generation and continues to invest heavily in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: VMAX emphasizes its proprietary core technologies, high integration levels, and multifunctional capabilities in onboard power supplies and electric drive systems. Its products feature high power density, reduced size and weight, cost efficiency, and advanced functions such as bidirectional charging (V2X). The company’s automated production and quality control systems ensure high reliability and timely delivery, while its broad customer base and global market presence enhance its competitive positioning.
